title: Add MessageEnvelope, Bus, UI Feed integration, Safety Gate routing, and coverage

gates.name: publication integration suite
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/publication backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security && npm test

verify: MessageEnvelope, Bus, and UI Feed integration preserves publication and context boundaries end to end.
Physical-action recommendations route through Safety Gate before user-visible action wording, action-task creation, or agent-consumable Bus wording.
evidence_required: End-to-end integration tests for runtime decision to MessageEnvelope to Bus/UI projection.
Pre-clearance physical-action wording tests showing safe Safety Block, clarification, or approval-pending refs only.
Generated OpenAPI validation after schemas exist and UI/e2e smoke evidence.
constraints: Pre-clearance physical-action wording must not be published to agent-consumable Bus context.
Full Safety Gate and action-task unlock remain owned by later FT-012 and FT-013.
invariants: Physical-action advice must fail closed unless fresh data, Safety Gate pass, authorized human approval, and task/action tracking exist.
T3 closure requires /verify PASS, /red-verify semantic-pass, human checkpoint, and rollback/recovery note.
verification_targets: Pre-clearance physical-action wording blocked from agent-consumable Bus context.
